# Target

For $a_0=0$, $a_1=1$, $a_{n+2}=2a_{n+1}+a_n$, determine whether $a_{n+1}a_{n-1}-a_n^2=(-1)^n$ for every integer $n\geq1$.

proofs/base.md.utf8:
# First-index identity

The recurrence and initial conditions give $a_2=2$. Hence $a_2a_0-a_1^2=2\cdot0-1^2=-1=(-1)^1$. This proves only the $n=1$ restriction; it does not prove the quantified target. The contemporaneous calculation and inputs are also pinned from [the dashboard](../RESEARCH_STATUS.md).
